parts: I was asked if I could look at some Shiny and make some changes for a friend of mine. I have the source but he has give me his Shiny.io log credentials so I can get it. messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: R Source on Shiny.io Question
parts:
Jason,
It is technically against our terms of service for your friend to share his credentials with you :) I would suggest finding a different way for the two of you to collaborate.  

That being said, your friend can give you the code he has deployed on shinyapps.io by downloading the bundle from the application tab within the shinyapps.io dashboard for his account.

Hope this helps.
Tareef
